notes: Development-time pins (frozen for v1). vendor/upstream/ is gitignored; run scripts/fetch-upstream.sh or .ps1 to populate and pass --check / -Check to verify. To move a pin: edit this file first, then update docs/research.md, then re-run fetch.

upstream.name: agent-client-protocol
upstream.role: ACP specification and schema/v1 JSON Schema; the frontend Dart types are generated from it

upstream.name: rust-sdk
upstream.role: agent-client-protocol crate (2.1.0): client role in the Rust core, agent role in the zed-agent-acp sidecar

upstream.name: registry
upstream.role: official agent registry: agent.schema.json, registry.schema.json, one directory per agent (agent.json + icon.svg); CDN registry.json is its build output

upstream.name: zed
upstream.role: reuse pool: crates/project/src/agent_registry_store.rs + agent_server_store.rs (copy), crates/agent_servers/src/acp.rs (transcribe), crates/acp_thread/src/terminal.rs (transcribe), crates/agent + crates/eval_cli (sidecar); node_runtime / http_client / reqwest_client / paths / util are gpui-free and linkable

upstream.name: pi-acp
upstream.role: first-class agent: npx pi-acp (no fs/terminal delegation, terminal auth)

upstream.name: dsh-acp-interactive
upstream.role: first-class agent (own project): reference agent for round 1, widest capability surface

upstream.name: deepseek-harness
upstream.role: upstream that dsh-acp-interactive composes; asset source only: apps/web/public/favicon.svg is copied into rust/acp-core/assets/dsh-icon.svg (no code dependency)

docs_only.name: cursor-cli-acp
docs_only.pin: registry entry cursor/agent.json version 2026.09.02 (binary distribution, command `agent acp`)
